description: Default capabilities for LocalConvert - Phase 1 (Secure Desktop Foundation): trimmed to exactly what the frontend calls, with fs/asset-protocol access to arbitrary user files granted per-file at runtime (see security::fs_scope) rather than as a static broad directory grant. No static fs:scope entry: the frontend never reads/writes $APPDATA or $APPLOCALDATA directly (grep-verified - the app-data directory is only touched from Rust, which isn't gated by capabilities), so there is nothing for a static grant to cover.
